performance_metrics.portfolio_duration_description: Maximum single-intervention lead time is 3 months (does not constitute a sequential Gantt critical-path schedule).

portfolio.title: Shaded Bus Stops & Public Cooling Kiosks with Drinking Water
portfolio.prerequisite_verification_note: Suitable based on current ward vulnerability screening criteria.
portfolio.scientific_rationale: Cooling kiosks provide acute localized commuter relief; numerical effect on macro ward-level surface temperature is physically negligible and unavailable.
portfolio.benefit_provenance: Qualitative commuter welfare score; no macro-temperature reduction claimed.
portfolio.rationale: Selected 12 station kiosk by MILP optimizer. Targets heat_exposure_proxy (Ward score: 58.4/100) with unit utility 62.2 pts under equity factor 1.0x.
portfolio.selection_justification: Allocated under budget ceiling INR 5,000,000. Contributes 746.3 prioritization utility points.

portfolio.title: Cool Roof Reflective Coating in High-Density Receptors
portfolio.prerequisite_verification_note: Suitable based on current ward vulnerability screening criteria.
directional_effects: Indoor thermal comfort in uninsulated tin/asbestos housing
portfolio.scientific_rationale: High-albedo solar-reflective coating reduces treated roof surface temperatures by 2-3°C, moderating ward-level heat proxy.
portfolio.cost_provenance: Market rate estimate for elastomeric high-albedo coatings; assumes municipal or community permission.
portfolio.benefit_provenance: Well-established surface physics; macro-ward heat effect depends on treated roof area fraction.
portfolio.rationale: Selected 15 building cluster by MILP optimizer. Targets heat_exposure_proxy (Ward score: 58.4/100) with unit utility 68.4 pts under equity factor 1.0x.
portfolio.selection_justification: Allocated under budget ceiling INR 5,000,000. Contributes 1026.7 prioritization utility points.

portfolio.title: Decentralized Rainwater Harvesting in Municipal Complexes
portfolio.prerequisite_verification_note: Suitable based on current ward vulnerability screening criteria.
portfolio.scientific_rationale: Rooftop harvesting supplements non-potable institutional demand, dampening municipal water stress proxy.
portfolio.cost_provenance: Standard PMC rainwater harvesting rate for public buildings.
portfolio.benefit_provenance: Calculated assuming 700mm monsoon precipitation yielding ~140 kL recharge per unit.
portfolio.rationale: Selected 2 building installation by MILP optimizer. Targets water_stress_proxy (Ward score: 52.0/100) with unit utility 64.0 pts under equity factor 1.0x.
portfolio.selection_justification: Allocated under budget ceiling INR 5,000,000. Contributes 128.1 prioritization utility points.

portfolio.title: Critical Stormwater Drain Desilting & Inlet Trash Screens
portfolio.prerequisite_verification_note: Verified: Ward has mapped SWD network (9 chambers, 1.8% coverage).
portfolio.scientific_rationale: Desilting restores baseline designed pipe conveyance. However, it does not enlarge pipe capacity or provide a defensible numerical reduction in extreme storm flood probability.
portfolio.cost_provenance: PMC annual pre-monsoon desilting tender rate schedule.
portfolio.benefit_provenance: Directional maintenance benefit only; flood probability reduction unquantified.
portfolio.rationale: Selected 1 major drain ward section by MILP optimizer. Targets flood_screening_proxy (Ward score: 75.2/100) with unit utility 77.1 pts under equity factor 1.0x.
portfolio.selection_justification: Allocated under budget ceiling INR 5,000,000. Contributes 77.1 prioritization utility points.

portfolio.title: Urban Shade Corridors & Native Canopy Planting
portfolio.prerequisite_verification_note: Suitable based on current ward vulnerability screening criteria.
portfolio.scientific_rationale: Tree planting increases vegetative fraction along walkways, providing microclimatic shade and moderating green deficit.
portfolio.cost_provenance: PMC standard schedule of rates roadside plantation estimate; unverified for specific corridor utility conflicts.
portfolio.benefit_provenance: Screening heuristic (0-100); empirical cooling requires multispectral canopy verification.
portfolio.rationale: Selected 1 km corridor by MILP optimizer. Targets heat_exposure_proxy (Ward score: 58.4/100) with unit utility 66.4 pts under equity factor 1.0x.
portfolio.selection_justification: Allocated under budget ceiling INR 5,000,000. Contributes 66.4 prioritization utility points.

assumptions_and_limitations: Objective values represent estimated prioritization utility, NOT validated reductions in physical disaster damage.
Costs are municipal engineering heuristics and exclude land acquisition, inflation, or specialized subcontractor markups.
Workforce demand estimates assume standard municipal crew productivity without factoring weather or monsoon work stoppages.
Site suitability checks reflect OpenCity and PMC spatial datasets; localized ground-truth site surveys remain mandatory prior to procurement.
